role: Validates Merkle chain integrity for shipped audit events — confirms hash linkage, sequence continuity, and detects tampering, by wrapping the real verification logic already implemented in @platform/audit rather than reimplementing it.
behaviorDescription: Given an ordered array of chained audit events, calls @platform/audit's verifyChain() (hash recomputation, prevHash linkage, sequence-gap detection) and turns any reported break into a block-severity Finding, since a verified chain break means either tampering or out-of-order shipping — both require human investigation. Records a Decision and signals the swarm whenever a break is found. fetchAndVerifyTenantChain() is an honest stub: it throws a clear error, because @platform/audit currently has no function to list/fetch a tenant's shipped S3 WORM events back out in sequence (shipper.ts only writes forward and exposes the current chain-tip hash).
hardStops: Never modifies, re-links, or re-hashes any audit event — verification only
Never fabricates a passing result when it cannot actually fetch a chain to verify — fetchAndVerifyTenantChain() throws rather than returning a fake or empty pass
Reuses @platform/audit's own verifyChain() rather than reimplementing Merkle verification logic independently
